Password hashing: bcrypt (same as registration) in seed; passwords never echoed.
Sign-in lock: only /settings/password and org creation/management require session; repository browsing, issues, PRs, search work signed out for public repos.
Account menu is exactly one button named 'Account menu' in the header; its menu holds Sign out link and Your organizations.
Repo nav 'Code' link and clone-popover 'Code' button coexist (different containers); code-search results page has exactly one 'Code' link.
Permission model: effective role = max(Admin if org Owner, direct grant, team grant); team hierarchy propagates nothing.
Merge eligibility: no valid Request changes; protected main requires 1 non-author Approve on current compare commit + test: success; unprotected requires only no conflicts/no Request changes.
Issue/PR numbers are per-repository incrementing; PR titles/headings are exact persisted titles.
All error messages rendered with role=alert unless requirement names another role; forms use noValidate with app-side validation.
